problemStatement.formal: -- Can central_binom_le_pow_prime_counting be proved via Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self?
problemStatement.plain: Can the product bound central_binom_le_pow_prime_counting (C(2n,n) ≤ (2n)^π(2n)) be proved by reconstructing the central binomial coefficient from its prime factorization using Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self, rather than via the existing inequality chain? The Kummer theorem connection (v_p(C(2n,n)) = number of carries) is also relevant.
whyMatters: Provides a more conceptual proof of the central Chebyshev bound
Demonstrates Nat.factorization tooling for analytic number theory
Would enrich the chebyshev-pnt-bridge gallery entry with an alternative proof path

open: Whether the factorization route gives a cleaner/shorter proof
knownResults.goal: Prove or disprove that Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self gives a cleaner proof of the central Chebyshev bound
